evidence_quote: Here, we performed longitudinal, multidimensional profiling of peripheral immunity in patients with LA-HNSCC at baseline (BSL), one month (CRT-1M), and three months (CRT-3M) after platinum-based CRT.
rationale: The study examines immune dynamics after chemoradiation for head and neck cancer to inform checkpoint blockade timing. It does not address cardiovascular disease, cardiovascular risk, prevention, or cardiovascular treatment outcomes.
